name: log_report
description: Reads every svc-*.log in a directory and writes report.json keyed by file name with {errors, topCode, p95} (malformed lines ignored; nearest-rank p95). Returns a summary of files processed.
whenToUse: Whenever service logs need the per-file error/topCode/p95 report, including new daily logs.

dir.description: Logs directory relative to project root

out.description: Output path relative to project root

provenance.reason: log report needed now and for daily new logs
